item.tib: rgyal ba dmu sras mgon po'i rnam thar rtogs brjod
item.coloph: de ltar rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mtha' klas kyang / mdzad chen nyi ma'i grangs kyis sgo phye ba'i/ mkha' dus yon tan tshul du dbye ba yang / khab bzhes mdo dang mi nub mtshan mdor gsungs/ 'di nyid bkod pa'i yon tan bsam mtha' yas/ gang gA'i klung gi rdul grangs sangs rgyas kyi/ bgrang bar zin 'di don brjod mi long / bsod nams ches cher thob pa rgyal bas gsungs/ rnam dkar dge legs kun bzang sprin chen po/ sras bcas dgyes pa'i rol mo 'khrol bzhin du/ phyogs dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar ru/ dmigs med yongs su thim pa'i me tog 'thor/ bsod nams dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtsa ba brtan/ srid khams skal bzang bde skyid lo 'dab phyug rgyal bstan bshad sgrab 'khor lo'i ge sar bzhad/ thams cad mngon byang chub pa'i 'bras bu g.yur/ legs legs rgyal ba'i mdzad 'phrin mdzes mdzes zhing gi bkod pa yongs grub par/ snyan snyan yang dag rab spel gsal gsal nges pa'i dkar chag ra bas gtam/ dkar dkar bsod nams snang bas 'tshub 'tshub snyigs lnga'i mig sman rab bskyungs nas/ bzang bzang rdzogs ldan nges nges bde chen zhing du bgrod par shog bstan pa yun gnas bstan 'dzin phrin las rgyas/ bstan srid rab 'phel bstan skyongs sku tshe bsring / bstan srung nus che bstan sbyin 'byor bas phyug bstan pa'i don longs bstan gtso'i shis pa rtsol/ de ltar rgyal bstan srid zhu dang / 'gro kun phan bde kun bslang ste/ 'jig med smra ba'i seng ge des/ bgyis pa'i sarba mang+ga lam//
